summary: Request for verifiable differential audit feed (ordered sequence proofs) + completed security questionnaire bundle
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a bundle for a scheduled security audit: (1) a differential (incremental) SIEM export for their tenant covering 2025-12-01 to 2026-02-28 with verifiable sequence proofs (per-event sequence numbers, gap detection metadata, and hmac checksums), and (2) a completed security questionnaire (PDF) signed by Redwood SOC contact and a short attestation describing retention, replay/handoff guarantees, and retention exceptions.

Impact: Customer cannot complete a regulatory audit without sequence/gap proof + signed questionnaire. This blocks compliance sign-off for their internal auditors and could delay contract renewal.

Requested artifacts: differential export (gzip-parquet), manifest with resume tokens and per-file HMAC, per-event compact envelope with sequence_number and resume_token, signed manifest (x509), a filled security questionnaire PDF, and a short attestation email for legal.

Deadline: Customer requests delivery by 2026-03-10 (SLA P1).

Primary contact: FinCentra audit lead - Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fincentra.example> (cc: legal@fincentra.example).
steps_to_validate:
1) Verify manifest checksum and signature against KMS-attested key.
2) Replay differential export into a temporary SIEM index and confirm ordered sequence (no gaps) using sequence_number field.
3) Confirm resume_token semantics allow deterministic resume at sequence N.
4) Validate HMAC per-file using provided KEK/DEK mapping.
5) Confirm delivered questionnaire PDF has signed page and Redwood signatory name.
6) Share short attestation email draft with CS/Legal for approval.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis: duplicate sequence observed during finalization caused by concurrent segment uploads overlapping a window where resume_token advanced but old writer retried. Evidence: export logs show duplicate seq numbers in segment-0007, commit timestamps overlap by ~200ms. Mitigation: introduce commit lock for tenant exports and add idempotent producer IDs in segment metadata. Patch implemented in PR #1789. Also validated with backfill of affected range 1258200-1258400 and recomputed HMACs. No evidence of data loss beyond duplicates; duplicates de-duplicated by SIEM ingestion pipeline using (sequence_number, event_hash).
resolution: Workaround: Customer can ingest delivered export and enable dedupe-by-(sequence_number,event_hash) in SIEM. Permanent fix: commit-lock + idempotent producer metadata landed in PR #1789 and deployed to prod on 2026-03-04. Delivery: Full differential export (2025-12-01 to 2026-02-28) delivered 2026-03-08, includes: 1) gzip-parquet segments with per-event sequence_number and resume_token, 2) manifest.json.gz signed with x509 (attached), 3) per-file HMACs and verification instructions, 4) completed security questionnaire PDF signed by Redwood SOC lead (Nora Chen), 5) short legal attestation email template. Follow-ups: monitor next scheduled export for five runs for regressions; CS to confirm acceptance by 2026-03-15.
customer_confirmation: Pending (email sent 2026-03-08). Customer will confirm acceptance after ingest and legal review by 2026-03-15.
postmortem_action_items: 1) Add export commit lock per-tenant (done). 2) Add end-to-end integration test that replays segments and checks for duplicates (in backlog, ticket INT-40212). 3) Improve manifest to include segment generation timestamp and producer_id (done). 4) Update runbook for export re-run procedure and add SLA escalation steps (Confluence updated).
notes_for_sales_and_csm: Customer is enterprise FinTech; recommend CSM follow-up to confirm audit acceptance and offer a short tech-walkthrough for ingestion/deduping best practices. Track contract renewal conversation separately.
